data.description:
## Context
The default suite passes but five OpenAI-compatible provider tests emit `PydanticAIDeprecationWarning`: in pydantic-ai v2.0 the `openai:` model prefix will resolve to the Responses API by default; callers must use `openai-chat:` to preserve current Chat Completions behavior or opt into `openai-responses:` explicitly. The warning originates from `src/rebar/llm/runner.py:389` and test helper calls to `infer_model`.

## Reproduction
Run the named OpenAI-compatible provider unit tests with Pydantic AI deprecations promoted to errors. Current model inference emits the warning.

## Plan
Use rebar-debug to trace every configured OpenAI-compatible model path and prove which API semantics rebar currently promises. Present a behavior decision before changing prefixes if Chat Completions versus Responses changes payloads, structured output, or endpoint compatibility. Then repair all confirmed surfaces under held-out RED warning-as-error and provider-parity oracles.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All model-prefix construction and inference surfaces are inventoried with caller evidence.
- [ ] The chosen Chat Completions or Responses behavior is explicitly approved before any semantic change.
- [ ] OpenAI-compatible provider tests pass with Pydantic AI deprecation warnings promoted to errors.
- [ ] Structured-output and custom-endpoint parity remains green across supported providers.
data.title: OpenAI-compatible provider uses pydantic-ai prefix with announced v2 semantic change
